piles.label: Dark Leo & Shredder (deck 104)
piles.intro: Every pile card graded for the Orzhov Ninja deck. Cards in the deck show as in; the rest are the bench.

piles.label: Doesn't fit
piles.intro: Good cards for a different deck: the lifegain and aristocrats clusters, and cards that fight the Ninja count.

cards.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow
Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

Ayli, Eternal Pilgrim.text: Deathtouch 2-drop; the exile needs 35 life, which this plan reaches. The sac outlet eats Ninjas.

Feast of the Victorious Dead.text: Any creature dying (deathtouch blocks count) gains life and spreads counters at end step.

Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim.text: 2-drop deathtouch; every sneak entry and token gains 1; deaths drain.

Hardened Tactician.text: Sac a token: draw. Same F1 cost as Deadly Dispute.

Karai's Technique.text: Sneak {W}{B}: ±3/±3, either or both, and it returns an unblocked attacker.

Karai, Future of the Foot.text: Ninja; combat damage returns a creature card — to the battlefield when sneaked.

Kaya, Geist Hunter.text: +1 team deathtouch and a counter on a token; −2 doubles the commander's Ninja token. 3 mana.

Lurrus of the Dream-Den.text: Recasts 2-drops from the graveyard, which sneak rarely fills; Replicator took the slot.

Oath of Kaya.text: One-shot 3 damage + 3 life; the planeswalker clause rarely fires.

Ruthless Lawbringer.text: Enters → sacrifice a creature, destroy any nonland permanent; sneak returns re-buy it.

The Kingpin of Crime.text: Extort makes every spell a lifegain trigger; the 1/5 body does not attack. Deck 20's engine.

Baron Bertram Graywater.text: Tokens entering make a lifelink 1/1 once a turn; "{1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Draw a card" turns Treasure into cards. Replaced Enduring Innocence.

Elenda, the Dusk Rose.text: Counter whenever ANY creature dies (Teysa doubles; deathtouch makes it common); dies into lifelink tokens equal to her power (Sunborn doubles).

Elenda, Saint of Dusk.text: 4-mana lifelink; menace above 25 life (an evasive attacker the plan turns on), +5/+5 at 35.

Kaya the Inexorable.text: −3 exiles any nonland permanent; +1 protects a key creature.

Starseer Mentor.text: Flier; end-step drain 3 unless they sacrifice or discard.

Spirit-Sister's Call.text: Sacrifice a permanent to return one; slow.

Vona, Butcher of Magan.text: Lifelink 4/4; "Pay 7 life: Destroy target nonland permanent" each turn — the lifegain plan pays for repeatable removal. First in if interaction (14) needs a card.

Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.text: Enters → destroy a nonland, nontoken permanent; menace; sneak re-buys it.

Mister Negative.text: Swapping life totals is backwards when you are ahead on life.

Moment of Reckoning.text: Four destroy/return modes at 7 mana. Strong, expensive.

Primevals' Glorious Rebirth.text: Returns every legend from the graveyard; many legends here. 7 mana.

Turncoat Kunoichi.text: Ninja; sneak 4 exiles a creature for good.

Leonardo, Cutting Edge.text: Ninja with Sneak {W}: the cheapest sneak in the pile; lifelink, grows on lifegain.

Quintessential Katana.text: Counters, Ninja's Blades, My Precious and Sheltered by Ghosts already modify creatures for Envoy (owner).

Lita, Little Orphan Amphibian.text: A 2-mana Ninja that grows, makes Food or scries on every creature entering.

Leonardo, Sewer Samurai.text: Ninja; double strike (two combat-damage triggers, F3); recasts power-1 creatures from the yard on your turn — Splinter, Hamato Yoshi, Super Shredder, Leonardo, Cutting Edge.

The Last Ronin's Technique.text: Sneak {1}{W}, instant: three Ninja Turtle Spirit tokens tapped and ATTACKING — three Ninjas at once.

Dokuchi Silencer.text: Its removal needs a hit AND a creature discard — too narrow (owner).

Splinter, the Mentor.text: Menace Ninja 2-drop; a Mutagen token whenever a nontoken creature leaves — every sneak return counts.

Super Shredder.text: Menace Ninja that grows whenever ANY permanent leaves (sneak returns, deaths, removal).

Undead Hand Ninja.text: Deathtouch Ninja 2-drop; drains whenever creature cards leave your yard (Karai, Lurrus, Leonardo).

Swarm Saboteur.text: Ninjutsu {B}, deathtouch; a hit conjures Virus Beetle (more hand attack).

Biting-Palm Ninja.text: 3-mana ninjutsu for one hand exile on a hit; owner's cut.

Ninja's Blades.text: Job select makes a Hero token and makes it a NINJA; loot plus life loss per hit.

Ninja Teen.text: Drain whenever a creature leaves (every sneak return); level 2 gives the team MENACE; level 3 sneaks creatures from the yard.

Shark Shredder, Killer Clone.text: Ninja; first strike; a hit steals a creature from their yard, attacking.

Shredder, Unrelenting.text: 6/4 deathtouch Ninja for Sneak {3}{B}; lends deathtouch.

Shredder, Shadow Master.text: Ninja; its OWN hit takes half their life — a second half-life source that needs no Ninja count (the copy clause is blank in 1v1).

Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni.text: 6-mana Ninja (ninjutsu 5); Vito, Thorn took the slot and Replicator makes Ninja tokens.

Frodo, Adventurous Hobbit.text: Needs 3 life gained BEFORE it attacks.

Head of the Class.text: Discount for spells that target creatures; Killian does this.

Killian, Ink Duelist.text: Menace lifelink 2-drop; creature-targeting spells cost {2} less (Karai's Technique, removal, pumps).

Syr Vondam, Sunstar Exemplar.text: Menace vigilance 2-drop; grows on deaths and exiles (not on sneak returns).

Athreos, God of Passage.text: Dead creatures return to hand unless they pay 3 life.

Black Widow, Double Agent.text: A lone attacker gets first strike and menace — the one-attacker sneak setup; deathtouch.

Cloak and Dagger, Entwined.text: Deathtouch lifelink; enters → exile a card from hand or a creature; sneak returns re-buy it.

Indulging Patrician.text: 3-mana flying lifelink (a sneak enabler); 3 life in a turn drains 3.

Kambal, Profiteering Mayor.text: Your tokens entering drain 1; copies their tokens. 3 mana.

Kambal, Consul of Allocation.text: Drains only on their noncreature spells.

Tymna the Weaver.text: Card advantage capped at one a turn in 1v1 (owner); Exemplar and Yathan replace it.

Sorin, Solemn Visitor.text: +1: team +1/+0 and lifelink until your next turn; −2 flying token. Close to Vengeful Bloodlord; first in if a 4-drop opens.

Silverquill, the Disputant.text: 4-mana 4/4 flier; casualty needs instants and sorceries.

Sorin, Vengeful Bloodlord.text: "During your turn, creatures … you control have lifelink": every attacking Ninja becomes a lifegain trigger. The bridge card; −X reanimates.

Squall, SeeD Mercenary.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Squall, SeeD Mercenary.text: A lone attacker gets double strike (two hits, F3); a hit returns a ≤3 MV permanent.

Teysa Karlov.text: "Creature tokens you control have vigilance and lifelink": Ninja tokens, Turtles and Sunborn's doubled tokens gain life.

Vito, Fanatic of Aclazotz.text: 4/4 flier; sacrificing Treasure gains 2 / drains 2 / makes a 4/3 flier each turn. First in if a slot opens (costs Barbed Servitor's draw and protection if forced).

Wispdrinker Vampire.text: Its drain on small creatures entering is Elas's job at half the cost.

Arvad the Cursed.text: 5-mana legend anthem; Teysa took the slot.

Closing Statement.text: Instant creature/planeswalker kill, cheaper at your end step.

Syr Vondam, the Lucent.text: 5-mana deathtouch lifelink; enters/attacks gives the team +1/+0 and deathtouch, so non-Ninjas trigger the Widows too.

Athreos, Shroud-Veiled.text: Coin counters return dying creatures. 6 mana.

Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel.text: Pay the life you gain to draw that many. WWBB: 67% on turn 5, a late card.

Blot Out the Sky.text: X Inklings; its wipe needs X ≥ 6.

Meticulous Commons.text: Untapped only with a planeswalker out.

White Widow, Yelena Belova.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
White Widow, Yelena Belova.text: Every deathtouch creature that connects grows — and attacking Ninjas all have deathtouch.

Black Widow, Deadly Hunter.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Black Widow, Deadly Hunter.text: A card per deathtouch creature that connects: under the commander, every Ninja hit draws.

The Cloning of Shredder.text: 6 mana and needs a creature card in the graveyard, which sneak rarely leaves.

Sally Pride, Lioness Leader.text: Enters with a 2/2 per nontoken creature; attacks put a counter on each creature — mass counters for Envoy and Yathan. 5 mana.

Ajani's Welcome.text: 1 mana: every creature entering gains 1. Elas does this on a body.

Speaker of the Heavens.text: 1-drop lifelink; makes 4/4 flying Angels once you are 7 above starting life — reachable here.

Belladonna Took.text: Token triggers: gain 1, then draw, then counters — needs two tokens a turn.

Griffin Aerie.text: 3 life in a turn makes a 2/2 flier — easy here, but a 2-mana card that does nothing alone.

Leader's Talent.text: A counter on an attacker every attack; level 3 counters the team per spell.

Sheltered by Ghosts.text: 2-mana exile of any nonland permanent, plus lifelink and ward on your creature.

Black Panther, Claws of Bast.text: Lifelink 3/3; attacks-alone counter — fits the Squall/Black Widow, Double Agent lone-attacker turns.

Dr. Beverly Crusher.text: Lifegain triggers fire twice: Archangel, Exemplar, Patrician, Leonardo, Niv-Mizzet.

Envoy of the Ancestors.text: "Modified creatures you control have lifelink" — permanent; Katana attaches to every entering Ninja, and counters count.

Enduring Innocence.text: Draw capped at one a turn; Baron replaces the card flow (owner).

Ethereal Escort.text: 3-mana 3/3 lifelink; each enter/attack gives a card in hand perpetual lifelink — the Ninjas you sneak later.

Falcon, Joaquin Torres.text: Plenty of cheap fliers now; Starseer took the slot.

Gideon Blackblade.text: 3-mana 4/4 indestructible attacker on your turn; +1 grants lifelink or indestructible.

Light of Promise.text: An Aura falls off when sneak returns its creature.

Metropolis Reformer.text: 3-mana flier, you have hexproof; gains life when damaged.

MJ, Rising Star.text: Crusher doubles its counters, but a 2/3 with no evasion; Archangel already counters the team.

Practiced Offense.text: Counter on each creature + double strike or lifelink; flashback. Mass counters for Envoy/Yathan.

Teferi's Protection.text: Protection from a sweeper; nothing else.

Exemplar of Light.text: Flier that grows on lifegain and draws once a turn when it gets counters.

Rosa, Resolute White Mage.text: Each combat: a counter and lifelink on a creature. Target one that stays in (sneak strips counters).

The Wind Crystal.text: White spells cost {1} less; doubles lifegain; team flying + lifelink for an alpha strike.

The Wandering Emperor.text: Flash; −2 exiles a tapped creature, +1 a counter and first strike, −1 a token.

Archangel of Thune.text: Flier whose "whenever you gain life, +1/+1 counter on each creature" fires once per lifelink attacker; the counters switch on Envoy and Yathan.

Bond of Discipline.text: One-shot tap-down + lifelink; Sorin gives team lifelink every turn.

Captain America, Steve Rogers.text: 5-mana lifelink; attacks put a counter and indestructible on another creature.

Boon-Bringer Valkyrie.text: 5-mana flying first-strike lifelink; backup puts a counter on another creature.

Doctor Strange, Surgeon.text: Doubles lifegain; +2/+2 team at 10 above. Wind Crystal does the doubling cheaper.

Exalted Sunborn.text: Token DOUBLER: two Ninjas per commander hit, six from Last Ronin's Technique; Warp {1}{W} for the big turn.

Moogles' Valor.text: Instant: a lifelink 1/2 per creature and team indestructible — a wide lifegain burst and sweeper protection.

Tale of Tinúviel.text: Indestructible, reanimate, two lifelinks over three turns. Slow.

Inspiring Commander.text: 6 mana for draws on small creatures; Archangel took the slot.

Righteous Fury.text: Destroys tapped creatures — your attackers too.

Federation Outpost.text: Untapped from turn 3; gains 2 (a lifegain trigger) or surveils.

Toxin Analysis.text: 1-mana deathtouch + lifelink trick and a Clue.

Black Market Connections.text: Card, Treasure or a CHANGELING token each turn — a changeling is a Ninja.

Madame Null, Power Broker.text: Pay life equal to power to put that many counters on each creature that enters — sneaks and tokens. Lifegain pays for it.

Yathan Tombguard.text: Menace 3-drop; draws whenever a creature with a counter deals combat damage to a player — the repeatable card advantage that replaced Tymna and Doctor Doom.

Withering Curse.text: Infusion makes it destroy all creatures — yours too.

Barbed Servitor.text: Indestructible menace attacker that draws on a hit.

Doctor Doom, Unrivaled.text: Taps to draw; its win needs an empty library, not this deck's plan. Niv-Mizzet took the draw slot.

Enduring Tenacity.text: "Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much": Crusher makes it fire twice and The Wind Crystal doubles the life first.

Eradicator Valkyrie.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Eradicator Valkyrie.text: Flying lifelink 4/3; boast edict (sacrifice a token, not a Ninja card).

Erebos, Bleak-Hearted.text: Draw on deaths; devotion rarely met.

Daxos, Blessed by the Sun.text: 2-mana: gain 1 on each creature entering or dying.

Surgical Precision.text: Kill toughness 4+, or draw and gain 2.

Finale of Eternity.text: X removal for small creatures; Crusher took the slot.

Zero Point Ballad.text: Sweeper that hits your own creatures.

Veko, Death's Doorkeeper.text: Extort makes every spell a lifegain trigger; sacrifice a non-Spirit to return an enters-trigger creature that then costs {W/B}. A returned Ninja most likely stops being a Ninja.

Kingpin, Wilson Fisk.text: Menace 3/6 (an evasive body); Treasure only when you sacrifice, which this deck rarely does.

Tataru Taru.text: Draw, and Treasure off their off-turn draws.

Smothering Tithe.text: About a Treasure a turn in 1v1. Ramp with no Treasure payoff.

Deadly Dispute.text: Two cards for a token; the sacrificed token is a Ninja the commander counts.

Grim Hireling.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Grim Hireling.text: Two Treasures per connecting combat; Treasures become removal.

Pitiless Plunderer.text: Death trigger, so Teysa doubles it and Sunborn doubles each Treasure: 4 per death, fuel for Baron. Needs your creatures to die. Second choice.

Rev, Tithe Extractor.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Rev, Tithe Extractor.text: Deathtouch on attack; every connecting combat makes a Treasure and steals a card.

Ruthless Technomancer.text: Enters trigger (Teysa no, Sunborn doubles the Treasures); reanimates power-X creatures for X artifacts. One burst per entry. Third choice.

Revel in Riches.text: Treasure on their creature deaths; ten Treasures is far.

Vraska, Betrayal's Sting.text: 0: draw and proliferate (counters); −2 turns a creature into a Treasure. 6 mana.

Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff.text: Treasure on second spells; you lose life.

Vraska, Scheming Gorgon.text: 6-mana walker; Vona/Wind Crystal fill the top end.

Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier.text: 5/5 flying lifelink; creature spells get convoke; back face gives persist. Competes with Archangel at 5.

Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dea.text: A 2-mana FLYING attacker — an unblocked enabler for sneaks; the back half is repeatable ping removal.

Vincent Valentine.text: Grows when their creatures die; deathtouch makes that common. Trample lifelink back face.

My Precious.text: Equip → hexproof and can't be blocked: a guaranteed unblocked attacker for sneak every turn, or a protected commander. The Adventure half sacrifices a creature for two cards.

Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose.text: "Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life" — Enduring Tenacity at 3 mana; with both out and Crusher, one lifelink hit drains four times. {3}{B}{B}: team lifelink for a wide attack.

Replicator.text: "{2}, {T}: Create a tapped token that's a copy of target token you control" — copy the commander's Ninja token for the five-Ninja count (two with Sunborn), or a Treasure/lifelink token. Activate at their end step so the copy can attack.

Shambling Vent.text: W/B creature land (in for a Swamp): {1}{W}{B} makes it a 2/3 lifelink — a lifegain trigger late. Enters tapped; tempo-neutral by the 2026-11-21 land check.

Restless Fortress.text: W/B creature land; each attack drains 2 and gains 2, which Tenacity, Vito, Thorn and Crusher multiply. Enters tapped. Flex line: −Swamp.
